title: Hephzibah
summary: My delight is in her. (1.) The wife of Hezekiah and mother of king Manasseh (2 Kings 21:1).

inlines.v: My delight is in her. (1.) The wife of Hezekiah and mother of king Manasseh (2 Kings 21:1).
(2.) A symbolical name of Zion, as representing the Lord's favour toward her (Isa. 62:4).
